messages.text:
Hola a todos:

Un tostador de Puebla me pidió cotizar las etiquetas de seis cafés de origen. Mismo formato, cambia el nombre de la finca, las notas de cata y un color. ¿Ustedes cobran cada etiqueta como pieza o cobran el sistema y luego cada variedad aparte? No quiero quedarme corta pero tampoco espantarlos.

Itzel

¡Hola Itzel!

Te contesto desde el otro lado del mostrador: yo estoy en marketing de un tostador en Guadalajara. A nosotros nos funcionó que nos cotizaran el sistema completo (la bolsa base, la retícula y las reglas de color) y luego cada variedad nueva con un precio fijo. Así cuando sale un café de temporada ya sé cuánto va a costar antes de pedirlo, y el archivo de la bolsa le llega a Inés ya armado para mandarlo a la imprenta.

Gracias, Mariana

Mariana, ¿entonces están buscando diseñador para las bolsas? Si sí, te mando portafolio por privado, tengo varias etiquetas de mezcal.

Héctor Quiroga

¡Hola Héctor!

Ya tenemos diseñador. Era por Itzel.

Gracias, Mariana

Ah va, leí mal. Gracias.

Héctor

Gracias, Mariana, me sirvió mucho. Les voy a cotizar el sistema en $14,000 MXN y cada variedad en $1,800 MXN. Ya les cuento si muerden.

Itzel

facts: Itzel cotiza seis etiquetas de café de origen para un tostador de Puebla.
A Mariana su diseñador le cotizó el sistema completo y luego cada variedad nueva con precio fijo.
Mariana aclaró que su tostador ya tiene diseñador y no hay vacante.
Itzel va a cotizar el sistema en $14,000 MXN y cada variedad en $1,800 MXN.
Luis no participó.
truth.summary: En la lista, Itzel preguntó cómo cotizar etiquetas de café; Mariana contó que a su tostador le cotizaron el sistema y cada variedad aparte, Héctor creyó que buscaban diseñador y Mariana aclaró que no hay vacante.

subject: Brightwell staging: Donate button on mobile

messages.text:
Hi team,

Helen rang me this morning (on a Saturday, bless her). On staging, the Donate button in the mobile menu goes to a 404. Desktop is fine apparently. She wants to walk Ruth and two trustees through the new site on Monday at 9.

Any chance one of you could look before then? I know it's the weekend, I'll owe you a coffee.

F

Fiona Achterberg
Client Director, Acme Studio
acme.example

Hi team,

Stand down. Ruth's come down with something and Helen has cancelled Monday's walkthrough. They'll rebook for some time in March, so no weekend heroics needed and Anil can pick it up in the week.

F

Fiona Achterberg
Client Director, Acme Studio
acme.example

Nothing for anyone to do this weekend then.

For Monday, Anil: I had a quick look last night and it isn't the button. The mobile menu links to /donate/ with a trailing slash and the staging redirect rule only catches /donate. Should be a one-line fix.

Thanks,
Luis

Luis Cordero
Senior Product Designer, Acme Studio
3rd floor, 48 Turnmill Street, London EC1M 5RR
acme.example

othersOwe: Anil: fix the staging redirect for /donate/ (trailing slash)

keyDates.what: Brightwell trustee walkthrough of the new site at 9:00, cancelled because Ruth was ill

facts: The Donate link in the mobile menu on Brightwell's staging site returned a 404; desktop worked.
Helen cancelled the Monday walkthrough because Ruth was ill; they would rebook in March.
Cause: the mobile menu links to /donate/ with a trailing slash and the staging redirect rule only catches /donate.
truth.summary: Fiona flagged a 404 on the Brightwell staging site's mobile Donate link before a Monday trustee walkthrough, then said the walkthrough was cancelled; Luis found the cause and left the fix to Anil.

messages.text:
Hello lovely people

I'm running the Leaside 10k on Sunday 16 March for Leaside Food Bank, the one by Clapton Pond that runs out of tins every February. Trying to get to £300.

Page is here: https://give.leasidefoodbank.example/luis-cordero

No pressure at all, a fiver is lovely. The shins are grumbling a bit on the long runs but I'll live.

L

hey Luis

page says Sunday 23 March, not the 16th?

sent £10
The page is right, it's the 23rd. They moved it after the marsh flooded and I copied the date off the old flyer. Thanks for the tenner, legend.

Hi Luis,

Sponsored, £20. Good cause.

Your email says the 16th and the page says the 23rd, so I've assumed the page is right.

On the shins: worth noticing when it starts in a run and when it wears off. If it's there from the first km, or still there the next morning, that's the point to ease off. In the meantime, after each run:

Calf raises
3 sets of 15
Stop if it's sharp rather than a dull ache

Harriet

Harriet Lowe MCSP
Dalston Step Clinic, Dalston

keyDates.what: Leaside 10k (moved from 16 March after the marsh flooded)

facts: Luis planned to run the Leaside 10k for Leaside Food Bank, near Clapton Pond. His target was £300.
Sponsor page: give.leasidefoodbank.example/luis-cordero.
Mateo gave £10; Harriet gave £20.
The race moved from 16 March to 23 March 2025 after the marsh flooded.
Harriet's advice: calf raises, 3 sets of 15 after each run, stop if the pain is sharp; ease off if the shin pain is there from the first km or still there the next morning.
truth.summary: Luis asked friends to sponsor his Leaside 10k for Leaside Food Bank; Mateo spotted that his email gave the wrong date and Luis confirmed the race is on Sunday 23 March, not the 16th; Harriet sponsored him and gave shin advice.
